health_gradient.scope: Actual EnemyBars drawing with the installed HD Lands battle atlas; full, 75%, 50%, 25% and empty health. Full pack mounting is covered separately.

hd_cliffs.scope: HD pack mounted by local wrapper; rendered zone1, zone11 and zone15; on/off, restored, dependency and unclassified controls.

hd_transitions.scope: HD pack mounted by local wrapper; zone1 authored-path protection, natural/detailed/original/disabled modes; rendered pixel checks.

source_equivalence.detail: Final cloud, swamp and water checks used 289 compiled scripts byte-identical to the release. Earlier UI and HD checks retain the focused implementation files listed below; localization and the unrelated new option keys in game_data have their own coverage.

portrait_lighting.comparison: Same original models, texture assets, camera and frozen poses. Old key energy 1.25 / ambient (0.42,0.42,0.45); new key 0.65 / ambient (0.7,0.7,0.7). New lighting applied to the real Paperdoll viewport for the A/B captures.
portrait_lighting.changes: Paperdoll preview lighting only; world lighting and model normals unchanged.

surfaces.scope: Final compiled scripts; HD Lands 1.5.0 mounted. Four authored swamps change and ignore a substituted liquid atlas; four ordinary-water/lava controls remain byte-identical. Held and animated frames checked.

world.scope: Two complete original zones, noon/night, overhead/low camera, HD Lands mounted; mirror enabled. Map-edge fog suppressed for material inspection.

gles.scope: Real Compatibility renderer: composed sampler limits, ordinary-water/lava controls, empty and active interaction history.

swamp_review.appearance: Murky olive/green body, broad suspended-sediment variation, moving normals and softened blue sky. The swamp shader never samples the authored swamp atlas; the existing shared procedural noise supplies variation.
swamp_review.comparison_limit: Other-renderer screenshots use different texture assets, lighting and cameras; no performance or visual-parity claim is made from them.

reflection_composition.scope: Three cloud qualities, three reflection settings, four wave/rain/zero-weight states. Exact unchanged-backend and held/restored images; qualified branch reordering differs by at most 1/32768 linear intensity.

reflection_lifecycle.scope: Actual world: held sky reuse, flash, camera rotation, hidden/inactive world, no-water view, return and option teardown. Held shadow aiming also publishes actual sun direction.

shadow_lifecycle.scope: Same-frame sun changes, held weather, night, ownership transfer, rapid toggles and released GPU textures.

shadow_projection.scope: 83 rendered checks across regions, storms, sun angles, altitudes and abrupt changes; direct-integrator fallback retained outside the field, above the cloud base and at low sun.

limits: Game simulation and camera were held; clouds advanced manually by 1/60 second per frame. This is a rendering workload, not whole-game performance on the reported laptop.
The candidate includes the swamp material change; it is not an isolated single-option microbenchmark.

The baseline off-controls drifted from 3.844 to 5.716 ms overhead and were about 6.7 ms low; candidate off-controls were about 4.0 and 4.9 ms. Do not infer an overall FPS ratio or an isolated shadow speedup from these runs.
GPU values are one last-completed-frame diagnostic sample for each viewport, not distributions. Older probes synchronizing render-server getters inside the pacing loop are excluded.

reflection_overhead_comparison.scope: First two overhead settings; local observation only.

linked_chat_integration.limits: On-device tests used an isolated Android 13 QA container; the final production template has matching qualified Java code and unchanged native engine libraries. No Redmagic/Adreno 840 driver-fault reproduction or fix is claimed.

lost_in_astral.scope: Four Ingos maps; kill all eligible animals, loot about half, actual save/load and 200 ticks, then hub return and another 200 ticks.

original_campaign.scope: Three Ingos maps; same real save/load and hub-return sequence.

animal_persistence_investigation.conclusion: Animal resurrection was not reproduced. No persistence fix is claimed; the exact map and reload sequence remain uncertain.

great_mage_staff.scope: Actual LiA Rickunmori figure after the staff restoration, in an earlier unpublished 1.5.0 package. Staff implementation unchanged in the release. Rendered staff capture inspected.

original_shop_reference.scope: Original base-game executable; no claim about the separate LiA executable.
original_shop_reference.findings: Eight rune positions around the slot, independent of artwork scale. Counts right-aligned in x+15..85,y+15..35; prices centred in x+15..85,y+65..85. Labels draw after icons and runes.
original_shop_reference.release_adjustment: Compact clusters remain default. Optional original ring retains full-size artwork and raises completed-spell prices to y+49..69 only when rune positions 3, 4 or 5 are occupied; otherwise keeps y+65..85.

performance_and_network.scope: Local single-run comparisons. Final source includes 1.4.0 changes and the new archer behavior; the 1.3.1 performance-only comparison isolates geometry reuse and small-component relocation. No Windows or user-hardware FPS claim.
performance_and_network.hardware: Ubuntu 24.04.5, NVIDIA RTX 3090, patched Godot 4.7 shipping runtime, Vulkan Forward+, isolated user profiles
performance_and_network.mansion: Persistent post-warm-up spikes were not reproduced locally. CPU geometry reuse fixes confirmed synchronous readbacks while the rain-cover map is built, but that alone does not explain persistent drops after several minutes.
performance_and_network.ingos: Seven-map headless simulation comparison is recorded separately from rendered FPS in the referenced record.
performance_and_network.network: Reported teleporting was not reproduced in the baseline or candidates. No networking algorithm/protocol change is claimed. CPU stall fixes address a plausible contributing delay, not a proven network root cause.
performance_and_network.network_method: Real ENet external guest and rendered host frontend with a separate authoritative LocalHost worker. Ready-synchronized 12-second short, long and mixed command bursts (~18–20 commands/s), then a 12-second settle phase. Reachable map destinations at about 3 m and 20 m. Separate isolated profiles.
performance_and_network.network_simulation: Built-in latency/jitter/loss injection at both peers; not an actual ZeroTier overlay. Harsh case also injects a 180 ms guest frame stall every 4 seconds.

release_template_provenance.java_template_build: generateGodotTemplates --offline; all native SCons tasks excluded

limits: Windows and macOS packages were exported and audited but not executed on their native operating systems. macOS uses the unsigned stock engine.

The Android release APK was exported, signature-checked and audited; no new on-device 1.5.0 gameplay run was performed. Native engine libraries retain the validated 1.4.0 template; the Java startup recovery additions use the separately qualified production template linked above.
Rendered checks used Linux Vulkan Forward+ plus targeted GLES Compatibility fixtures. Cross-platform compiled-script identity does not substitute for testing every GPU or renderer.

Earlier Suslanger FPS measurements include changes introduced in 1.4.0; the isolated 1.3.1 patch comparison is recorded separately. No performance claim is made about the final HD texture-pack correction or another renderer.

Persistent mansion dips, multiplayer teleporting and animal resurrection were not reproduced under the tested conditions. Simulated delay, jitter and packet loss used real ENet peers, not an actual ZeroTier overlay.

The original ring preserves native upper-right rune/count positions; the default compact layout reserves count space. Both keep prices clear; the ring moves prices only when its bottom row contains runes.
Web checks cover fresh setup and service-worker upgrade with imported-data/save sentinels, not a complete browser campaign.
